test_boost_readlink_builtin: test the Boost.Build READLINK built-in function by creating a symlink and verifying it resolves to the target file
create_symlink_test: create a symlink pointing to a target file and test that READLINK resolves it correctly in a Jamfile
run_boostbuild_tester: run a BoostBuild.Tester instance that writes a Jamfile, executes the build system, and validates stdout output
review_symlink_environment_patch: review how the test patches MSYS and CYGWIN environment variables to enable native strict symlinks on Windows
summarize_readlink_jamfile: summarize a Jamfile that uses READLINK to resolve symlinks and EXIT to verify the resolved path
